answers.text: Benzatropine side effects include the common peripheral anticholinergic side effects including dry mouth, blurred vision, difficulty in micturition and constipation.
Benzatropine may help in the management of Parkinson’s disease in the early stages, decreasing the imbalance between the neurotransmitters acetylcholine and dopamine
Benzatropine may help as an additional drug later in the course of the disease when Sinemet becomes less effective on its own
